posts.author: Cherry
posts.body:
Well, you could start basic, by just using the "Show Choice" event command:
Disable the default title screen in the database (uncheck the "Use" checkbox next to the title screen graphic in the "System" tab).
Set the initial party to empty so no player character is visible when the game starts.
Create a map to serve as your custom title screen, for example make it empty and set a panorama image. Set the map as starting point.
Create an autostart event on that map which uses "Show Choice" to ask the player whether to start a new game, load a saved game or quit.
In the "start a new game" branch, teleport the player to the map on which the real game should start and add the relevant actor(s) to the party.
In the "load game" branch, use the "Open Load Menu" event command.
In the "exit game" branch, use the "Exit Game" event command.
Once you see these things working, you could improve it by replacing the choice window with some picture-based menu. You would use a variable to store which menu item is currently selected and use the "Key Input Processing" event command to wait for up/down/enter presses and respond to them by checking what the currently selected menu item (based on your variable) is and then selecting another item (also updating your pictures to reflect the selection change) or executing the desired action on enter press, respectively.

posts.body: Well you can (and probably will want to, eventually) use pictures. The choice idea was just as a simple solution to get the logic working and then continue from there. But I am a bit confused why you meant by using "transfer map" between the two choices... you just need to update your variable to the current choice and update the pictures displayed to reflect it. You should need to transfer the player to a new map only in the case of "begin" when the actual game should start.

posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
If you are interested, you can check if there are Savefiles in the game to make the menu accessible only in this situation:
It would be something like this:
Code:
@> Display Text Options: Normal, Middle, Fixed, Stop Event Movement
@> Conditional Branch: Savestate is available
  @> Show Choices: New Game, Load, Exit
   : When [New Game]
    @> Display Text Options: Normal, Middle, Automatic, Stop Event Movement
    @> Hide Screen: Default
    @> Change Party Member: Add [Zack]
    @> Transfer Player: [0002:MAP0002] (009,004), Retain
    @> Show Screen: Default
    @>
   : When [\c[3]Load]
    @> Open Load Menu
    @>
   : When [\c[0]Exit]
    @> Exit Game
    @>
   : Branch End
  @>
 : Else
  @> Show Choices: New Game, \c[3]Load, \c[0]Exit
   : When [New Game]
    @> Display Text Options: Normal, Middle, Automatic, Stop Event Movement
    @> Hide Screen: Default
    @> Change Party Member: Add [Zack]
    @> Transfer Player: [0002:MAP0002] (009,004), Retain
    @> Show Screen: Default
    @>
   : When [\c[3]Load]
    @> Play SE: 'Buzzer1', 100, 100, 50
    @>
   : When [\c[0]Exit]
    @> Exit Game
    @>
   : Branch End
  @>
 : Branch End
but there are ways to improve and reduce this and include transition effects:
Code:
@> Display Text Options: Normal, Middle, Fixed, Stop Event Movement
@> Conditional Branch: Savestate is available
  @> Show Choices: New Game, Load, Configurations, Exit
   : When [New Game]
    @> Control Variables: [0001:Title-Choice] = 1
    @>
   : When [Load]
    @> Control Variables: [0001:Title-Choice] = 2
    @>
   : When [Configurations]
    @> Control Variables: [0001:Title-Choice] = 3
    @>
   : When [Exit]
    @> Control Variables: [0001:Title-Choice] = 4
    @>
   : Branch End
  @>
 : Else
  @> Show Choices: New Game, \c[3]Load, \c[0]Configurations, Exit
   : When [New Game]
    @> Control Variables: [0001:Title-Choice] = 1
    @>
   : When [\c[3]Load]
    @> Play SE: 'Buzzer1', 100, 100, 50
    @> Control Variables: [0001:Title-Choice] = 0
    @>
   : When [\c[0]Configurations]
    @> Control Variables: [0001:Title-Choice] = 3
    @>
   : When [Exit]
    @> Control Variables: [0001:Title-Choice] = 4
    @>
   : Branch End
  @>
 : Branch End
@> Conditional Branch: Variable [0001:Title-Choice] == 1
  @> Display Text Options: Normal, Middle, Automatic, Stop Event Movement
  @> Hide Screen: Default
  @> Change Party Member: Add [Zack]
  @> Transfer Player: [0002:MAP0002] (009,004), Retain
  @> Show Screen: Default
  @>
 : Branch End
@> Conditional Branch: Variable [0001:Title-Choice] == 2
  @> Open Load Menu
  @>
 : Branch End
@> Conditional Branch: Variable [0001:Title-Choice] == 3
  @> Open Video Options
  @>
 : Branch End
@> Conditional Branch: Variable [0001:Title-Choice] == 4
  @> Exit Game
  @>
 : Branch End
